richiami.difetto: An issue with the front axle of certain Kubota M6 tractors (the “Concerned Units”) has been identified whereby cracks may cause the axle to malfunction or break during normal operation. This may cause the front wheel(s) to detach and/or significantly affect steering.
richiami.rimedio: Kubota intends to replace the front axles of the Concerned Units. Additionally customers with Concerned Units that are equipped with front axles with more than 800 hours of use are advised to stop using their tractor until the front axle has been replaced.
richiami.titolo: Kubota M6 Tractor front axle recall

richiami.difetto: Kubota has identified that in specific circumstances during drives on the road for long periods of time at high speed and without pushing the brake pedal pushing the brake pedal for the first time may not properly activate the braking system due to the presence of air in the brake pipe. Pushing the brake pedal again 2-3 times allows for proper braking.
richiami.rimedio: Dealers will follow a specified procedure which involves (i) cleaning certain parts of the braking system; (ii) supplying new oil to the braking system; and (iii) bleeding the air from the brake system.
richiami.titolo: Kubota MGX-IV and M6 series

richiami.difetto: Kubota has identified that due to poor tightening of the bolts and nuts that connect the front suspension arm and the ball joint some of its utility vehicles RTV-X1110 may present a safety issue whereby a wheel could detach and the vehicle could become inoperable.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect if any bolts or nuts are damaged replace the related parts with new ones if damaged. Tighten all to the specified torque.
richiami.titolo: Kubota RTV-X1110

richiami.difetto: An issue with the front axle of certain Kubota M6 tractors has been identified whereby quenching cracks formed during manufacture of the axles may cause the axle to break during normal operation of the tractor. This may cause the front wheel(s) to detach and/or significantly affect steering.
richiami.rimedio: Check axle stamp. If necessary replace both front axles.
richiami.titolo: Kubota M6 Tractor front axle recall
